The '''Forest of Broken Glass''' was a region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Durace]], in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The forest did not contain any [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and it's name was derived from numerous silicate rock formations of various shapes and [[Color/Legends|colors]] that were situated in the region. The formations reflected [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts and were highly resistant to damage. However, strong winds sometimes caused some of the larger formations to shatter into sharp shards, which proved to be a dangerous hazard to any travelers that passed through the forest. The creatures that evolved to live in the Forest of Broken Glass were rumored to be very receptive to the [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemical techniques]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="TUR" />
